verdict.rationale: Authy is a 2FA authenticator app and Twilio API service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis to judge it on. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent connection. The SDK and Verify API are developer building blocks rather than an MCP server, and the probe shows the Authy API is closed to new customers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
